authorization: User requested navigation tests with0.5m success radius and approved small-scale debugging followed by320 formal tests.
model_selection: Use the normalized arm selected by validation before Stage11 test inference; never choose weights or tune the controller on navigation outcomes.
success_definition: After each executed position update, check simulator-ground-truth horizontal distance<=0.5m and end the episode immediately. Endpoint checks match the original code; crossing a circle between endpoints is logged separately, not counted as success. Initial-inside cases are excluded from nontrivial success rates.
supervision: Ground truth is used for evaluation, pose execution verification and boundary/clearance guards. Only engineering oracle runs use a true home vector for decisions. Network-policy input is full RGB/255 only; yaw is used solely for body/world conversion and action execution. No distance-to-home feedback, terminal step shortening, APF, or pose input is added to the neural policy.
scope: Original-style discrete kinematic camera/robot-proxy navigation at40m AGL. No quadrotor dynamics, braking/hover validation, autonomous home recognition or landing. All scene surfaces are below the flight plane; no obstacle-avoidance capability is claimed.
recording: Save every decision RGB, frame/pose/optics/stability receipt, body/world prediction, planned/executed displacement, pre/post distance, termination reason and episode summary. Interrupted episodes restart from their fixed initial state in a new preserved attempt; committed completed episodes are verified and reused.
